title.es: Aquel en el que Tasio se hace socio
title.en: The One Where Tasio Becomes a Partner

description.es: Damián les comunica a Marta y a Andrés que Tasio será su socio en su nueva empresa, lo que disgusta a ambos.
description.en: Damián informs Marta and Andrés that Tasio will be his partner in his new company, which upsets both Marta and Andrés.
